indication.text: Treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (WHO Group 1) in patients with WHO class II or III symptoms to improve exercise capacity and delay clinical worsening

citations.quote: LETAIRIS is indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (WHO Group 1) in patients with WHO class II or III symptoms to improve exercise capacity and delay clinical worsening.

target_moa.text: High-affinity, highly ET_A-selective endothelin receptor antagonist that blocks ET_A-mediated vasoconstriction and cell proliferation in PAH

citations.quote: Ambirsentan is a high affinity (K_i=0.011 nM) ET_A receptor antagonist with a high selectivity for the ET_A versus ET_B receptor (>4000-fold).
LETAIRIS is the brand name for ambrisentan, an endothelin receptor antagonist that is selective for the endothelin type-A (ET_A) receptor.
The primary actions of ET_A are vasoconstriction and cell proliferation, while the predominant actions of ET_B are vasodilation, antiproliferation, and ET-1 clearance.

LETAIRIS is an endothelin receptor antagonist indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (WHO Group 1) in patients with WHO class II or III symptoms to improve exercise capacity and delay clinical worsening (1).
